identified_defects.description: In driver load(), all 4 GP history values were set from r[1] (which is d0_1 damage bound) instead of reading authentic r[4+g] columns, corrupting 61,008 transferred integration-point histories.
identified_defects.remediation: Restore R3-compatible history loading using float(r[4+k]) for k in 1..4 from d_lower_bounds.csv. Validate all 61,008 integration-point histories against authentic transferred CSV, verifying nonuniform values and strict positivity.

identified_defects.description: In driver _deck(), split_keyword_blocks() output was iterated as 'for name, lines in blocks', but split_keyword_blocks returns List[str], causing incompatible string tuple unpacking.
identified_defects.remediation: Restore string-based keyword block parsing from R3 driver. Ensure mechanical and phase decks are generated correctly without tuple unpacking.

identified_defects.description: In driver _deck(), *INITIAL CONDITIONS, TYPE=SOLUTION emitted nodal displacement/damage records instead of preserving element-level solution-state formatting (16 SDVs per element across multiple lines).
identified_defects.remediation: Restore R3 element-level *Initial Conditions, type=SOLUTION serialization: 8 zeros followed by 0, H1..H4, 0, 0, 0, then 0, 0, 0 per element for all 15,252 quads.

identified_defects.description: In driver runner(), extractor was invoked with unsupported '--role' argument rather than verified '--physical-nodes 15559', '--physical-elements 15252', and '--step <step_name>' flags.
identified_defects.remediation: Restore verified extractor CLI arguments: --odb, --output, --physical-nodes 15559, --physical-elements 15252, --step C3_0_Step{step_idx}_{role}. Remove --role flag.
